integrity.verification_basis: analytic local-wedge proof, uniform implicit-function expansion, and reproducible independently seeded numerical checks

scientific_limitations: Only three independent unit-circle vertices sampled uniformly by arclength are covered.
The exact one-dimensional cutoff is asserted for sufficiently small positive deficits; no uniform extension across the entire distribution is claimed.
Total variation convergence holds for the three marked coordinates; the two normalized cost deficits converge jointly only weakly.
Numerical quadrature and Monte Carlo corroborate, not certify, the analytic proof.
Historical priority is provisional; some related geometric network sources were accessible only by abstract.
title: A two-term extreme-tail and independent marked shape law for circular three-point spanning trees
